Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original artwork for the Ronin collection of Azure Folio, a refined desktop wallpaper and split login-screen illustration, NOT a UI mockup. Landscape 16:10, highest available resolution, preferably 3200x2000. Exquisite fine Japanese woodblock linework combined with antique copperplate engraving: intricate hatching, stippled foliage, crisp contours, restrained beautiful detail. Blue ink #214C94 on warm near-white ivory #F7F4E9 ONLY, pale ink washes allowed, no other hues. The image will be recolored and precisely dithered by code; no coarse pixels or pre-dithering. Composition must survive a 21:9 ultrawide crop of the middle 65 percent of the image as well as the full 16:10 frame. Keep the complete principal figure and important landscape forms within that central horizontal band, with the figure around 65 percent from the left so a portrait crop also works. Create a coherent single panoramic scene with expansive negative space and richly etched areas. No text, calligraphy, stamps, red seals, logos, borders, panels, typography, interface, photographic rendering, 3D, anime or modern objects. The samurai's katana remains sheathed. Mood: solitary, contemplative, elegant, timeless. Scene: a lone wandering ronin in a flowing travel robe and woven kasa hat, seen from a three-quarter back view, quietly crossing an old gently arched stone footbridge over a shallow river. The small full-body figure occupies roughly 35 percent of image height, centered vertically, on the right half of the bridge. Graceful Japanese black pines, river reeds, carefully observed rocks, small distant traditional village roofs, and Mount Fuji emerging through a broad misty valley. Place Fuji's summit around one third from the top so it is not cropped on an ultrawide display. Let pale river and mist breathe on the left; balance fine etched pines and the ronin on the right. Beautiful detailed drapery, authentic restrained clothing, no armor spectacle or battle. A museum-quality travel print.
